defects.where: ember-3 CINDER CHASE - the cannon 'shaft-gun' at [30, 5.6, 6] on the cannon bluff: ROUTE C, one of the three routes the course header lists to the open crest
defects.did: walked at it from cp3, then teleported onto the breech itself and tried all three things a player would: walked into it, pressed E (interact), pressed Space (jump)
defects.happened: the hero never entered the 'cannon' state - the only states seen were idle, fall and land - and walking into the barrel puts him in 'bonk', pressed against it. Its own sign, which reads perfectly from the approach, says CLIMB IN AND IT FIRES. Code check: grep -rn enterCannon runtime/ finds only controller.js's own definition, and nothing in runtime/ reads the trigger volume's props.cannon / enter / fire that hazards/launch.js builds.
defects.should: walking into the breech should seat the hero in the cannon and fire him through the clerestory slot onto the balcony at 14.80; without it ROUTE C does not exist and the sign is a lie

defects.where: ember-3 CINDER CHASE - the chase clock at the moment control is handed over
defects.did: loaded the course six times and read course.clock on the very first frame the game reported state 'playing'
defects.happened: the chase clock already read 31.65, 31.38, 21.37, 13.72, 12.51 and 11.13 s - never under 11 s. The chase gives 40 s before the lava leaves the floor, so between 28 and 79 per cent of the head start was gone before I could take a step. Mechanism: game.js `simulating` includes 'cinematic', 'card' and 'dead', and course.update() is gated on `simulating && !simBlocked`, not on `frozen`, so the course clock runs through the loading screen, the intro, the course card and the death sequence.
defects.should: on the one course whose whole design is a 40 s head start, the clock must start when the player gets control. (The box carried 47-87 other Chrome processes, so the magnitude is inflated; the mechanism is not.)
defects.png: _shots/play_ember-3/01_00_spawn.png (dev overlay reads clock 32.41 s, deaths 0, player idle on the spawn pad)

worked: All three geyser jump pads launch on contact and throw hard: walked onto each from 2.2 m away off the 4.40 m terrace and peaked at 13.63 m (pad 1, power 9), 10.15 m (pad 2, power 6) and 10.47 m (pad 3, power 8). Shot 13_12_pad1_launch.png.

The chase resets FAIRLY at both checkpoints I could test. cp-court: the clock ran to 35.10 s, I died, and the respawn put it back to about zero (read 3.64 s, which is my own 2.5 s wait plus the death sequence). cp-gallery: entering set the clock to 30.55 s exactly as its clockOffset 30 says, and after forcing the clock to 70 s and dying it came back to 30.55.

Death -> rewind -> respawn is fast and good-looking: 432, 435, 530, 559 and 582 ms measured on the dev overlay, with the desaturated rewind ghost, the iris and a REWIND caption. Shot 05_54_front_at_70s.png.

The vanish ledges really do drop away on their cycle: standing on [6.5, 25.05, -26] my y fell from 29.30 to 6.00 - a 19 m fall to the shaft floor, survived. They glow before they go, exactly as their sign promises.
The rotor bars are rideable solids, not killers: I landed on the y-17.6 bar by accident and was carried along it. Shot 07_SIGN6_kick.png.

Every sign a player meets head-on reads clearly at a normal standing distance: CLIMB IN AND IT FIRES plus 'it aims through the tap-holes', STAND ON IT, THE LONG WAY IS THE DRY WAY, RIDE THE PLATE / MIND THE BARS, THEY GO WHEN THEY GLOW, and the CINDER CHASE billboard. Shots 01_SIGN0 through 09_SIGN8.

The safe-edge stripes carry the whole shaft: on the slag steps, the spiral ledges, the elevator plates and the exit ledge they are the one thing that reads in a very dark room, and they read well. Shots 02_51_chase_gallery.png, 08_SIGN7_they.png, 04_53_chase_top.png.
Checkpoints fire on contact and the HUD pip counts up correctly (0/5 -> 1/5 -> 2/5 -> 3/5 -> 4/5 observed).

The lava front's live numbers are exactly as authored: reading the hazard gives from 4.5, to 32.0, speed 0.8 m/s, delay 40 s - so it leaves the floor at t=40, takes the y-14 gallery at t=51.9, the mid deck at t=61.9 and stops at 32.0 m at t=74.4.

The slag-step spiral (BEAT 5) is comfortably inside the chase's pace: a hand-stepped autopilot ran the court floor -> S1 -> S5 in 15.0 s of course time, against 51.9 s before the front takes the gallery above it.

The course boots and runs clean: no console or page errors in any of the nine runs (console: [] every time), and draws 63-157 with 213k-330k triangles at every station I visited, inside the 260 / 450k budget.
The death banner's 'INCINERAT' frame I first flagged is NOT truncation: reading the overlay's DOM frame by frame shows no clipped element, so it is a per-letter reveal animation caught mid-flight.
blocked: ROUTE C could not be flown at all, because the cannon cannot be boarded (defect above) - so the balcony landing at 14.80, sigil 5 on the balcony tip and the whole skip-the-first-spiral line are untested.

I could not time a REAL entry through the Keep painting: after returnToKeep() the ember-3 gate read {unlocked: false, sealed: true} at [4.5, -5.5, -11] even though I had called __dev.unlockAll() before leaving, so the walk-in correctly refused and never raised the course card. All entry-clock numbers above are therefore from __dev.goto. Gate state is the gates lane's area, not mine.

The upper half of ROUTE B (plate -> mid deck -> chimney -> vanish spiral -> exit ledge) was toured by teleport-and-walk, not climbed end to end: my autopilot could not make the S5 -> gallery-sill hop and I could not build a good enough platforming bot in the time. I therefore cannot say whether a human can climb the whole shaft inside the chase's clock, only that the first spiral costs 15 s of the 51.9 s available.

Frame rate is not evidence this session: 47-87 Chrome processes from other lanes were on the box throughout. fps read 20-26 with p99 up to 3000 ms, and as a result game time ran at roughly a sixth of wall time (the clamped-dt effect HARNESS_NOTES documents). Every duration in this report is COURSE time read off course.clock, never the wall clock.
The Warden, the boss crest, the open crest on the caldera lip, sigil 8 on the east crag and the wing/rings overlay were not reached - the caldera stage was cut when the box ran out of headroom.
No sigil was collected. The east-pool sigil attempt drowned in lava twice before reaching the plug, and the shaft sigils sit on the half of ROUTE B I could not climb.
